source.note: Greek whole-milk yogurt strained further to ~70% weight; assumes only water is lost (slightly overstates carbs). Commercial full-fat labneh is often richer.
Gulf laban is a cultured whole-milk drink; USDA cultured whole buttermilk is the closest analysed match. Low-fat laban has ~1/2 the fat.

Soft Saudi variety; Medjool values used. Published Sukkari analyses (Frontiers in Nutrition 2025 review, doi:10.3389/fnut.2025.1651121) report similar carb/protein ranges on a dry basis; per-date weight is a typical estimate.
Semi-dry variety; Deglet Noor values used (Khalas studies report ~302–319 kcal/100 g as-is, close to this). Per-date weight is a typical estimate.
Madinah variety; no USDA record — Medjool values used. Per-date weight is a typical estimate.
No USDA record — Deglet Noor values used. Per-date weight is a typical estimate.
Fresh rutab holds more water than dried dates, so these Medjool values likely OVERestimate kcal by ~20–30%.
Similar leavened wheat flatbread; USDA naan values used. Whole-piece weight is an estimate (sizes vary a lot).
